sources.title: 2024 UN Annual Results Report: Papua New Guinea
sources.organization: United Nations Country Team, Papua New Guinea
sources.temporal_coverage: Reported programme achievements and ongoing/planned activities during 2024.
sources.methodology: UN Country Team annual results reporting for the 2024 Cooperation Framework.
sources.limitations: Self-reported programme outputs; longer-term outcomes were not evaluated.

sources.title: United Nations Highlands Joint Programme (Phase 2)
sources.organization: United Nations Development Programme, Papua New Guinea
sources.temporal_coverage: Phase 2 is stated to run January 2026–April 2028.
sources.methodology: Official UNDP project summary, outcomes and partner information.
sources.limitations: Programme aims and expected outcomes are not independently evaluated results; page gives no publication date.

sources.title: Flooding in Western Province Post-Disaster Needs Assessment Report: Papua New Guinea, April to July 2024
sources.organization: Government of Papua New Guinea, National Disaster Centre, and United Nations Development Programme
sources.temporal_coverage: Prolonged flooding and assessed impacts from April through July 2024.
sources.methodology: Official publication summary describes a joint post-disaster assessment of 60 villages and one care centre.
sources.limitations: Only the directly opened official summary was inspected; the 33-page report download was inaccessible in this review.

claims.locator: PDF p. 9, Social Cohesion and Displacement Tracking Matrix training.
claims.paraphrase: In 2024, 202 participants across Bougainville, East Sepik, Morobe, Enga, Western Highlands, Jiwaka and Simbu trained in displacement data, vulnerability assessment and response planning.
claims.limitations: Reported training output; no independent assessment of resulting response quality.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: Training supports responses to climate- and conflict-related displacement.

claims.locator: PDF p. 9, Agricultural Lab Centres in Hela.
claims.paraphrase: UN-supported Agricultural Lab Centres opened in conflict-affected Idauwi and Paipali, Hela, for community learning on sustainable agriculture, disaster-risk reduction, food security and resilience.
claims.limitations: The report describes services and purpose, not measured livelihood or peace outcomes.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: Centres are located in conflict-affected communities.

claims.locator: PDF p. 17, Bougainville community-based disaster-risk management.
claims.paraphrase: Bougainville's community-based disaster-risk plan launched in 2024; community work identified 12 disaster-prone areas and informed 12 projects.
claims.limitations: The report does not identify all 12 locations or evaluate project effects.

claims.locator: PDF p. 17, Building Resilience to Climate Change in PNG project.
claims.paraphrase: In nine of 24 vulnerable island and atoll communities, grants supported livelihood, food, sanitation and ecosystem activities; ward committees oversee transport dinghies, with over 16,000 people listed as expected beneficiaries.
claims.limitations: The 16,000 figure is the report's expected reach, not a verified final beneficiary count.

claims.locator: Project summary, provinces and contextual risks; no pagination.
claims.paraphrase: UNDP describes recurrent inter-group violence and displacement alongside growing climate and disaster-risk vulnerability in Hela, Southern Highlands, Enga and Western Highlands.
claims.limitations: The project page describes intersecting setting-level risks, not climate-caused violence.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: UNDP frames climate and disaster risks within the same conflict-affected programme context.

claims.locator: Programme outcomes and expected outcomes; no pagination.
claims.paraphrase: HJP2 aims to combine community conflict mediation, inclusive governance and services with local capacity to prepare for and adapt to climate-induced disasters, targeting women, youth, people with disabilities and displaced populations.
claims.limitations: These are stated programme aims and expected outcomes, not evaluated or completed results.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: The programme explicitly couples conflict prevention and peacebuilding with climate-disaster preparedness.

claims.locator: IRP publication page, assessment scope and findings; no pagination.
claims.paraphrase: The 2024 joint assessment covered prolonged flooding in 60 Western Province villages and one care centre, representing about 55,000 affected people.
claims.limitations: The directly opened publisher summary gives no village-level caseloads.

claims.locator: IRP publication page, sector impacts summary; no pagination.
claims.paraphrase: The assessment summary identifies contaminated water, food insecurity from damaged gardens, disease risks, displacement, damaged homes and schools, and heightened protection concerns in flood-affected communities.
claims.limitations: Only the official summary was inspected; it does not disaggregate these impacts by group or village.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: The summary explicitly includes displacement and protection concerns among flood impacts.

access_audit.locator: Opened the original 31-page PDF; claims use PDF pp. 9, 12 and 17.
access_audit.notes: The official UNDP publication page gives 9 April 2025; report describes 2024 achievements and distinguishes implemented from planned activities.
access_audit.reuse_terms: Terms not reviewed; concise paraphrases only.

access_audit.locator: Opened UNDP project summary, outputs, expected outcomes, locations and partner list.
access_audit.notes: Direct page states January 2026–April 2028 programme duration; no publication date is displayed.
access_audit.reuse_terms: Terms not reviewed; concise paraphrases only.

access_audit.locator: Opened IRP publication page and read its assessment scope and impact summary.
access_audit.notes: The original 33-page PDF download led to a cache miss and was not inspected; claims are limited to the directly opened page summary.
access_audit.reuse_terms: Terms not reviewed; concise paraphrases only.

access_audit.notes: Search-result text was not used as evidence; relevant displacement figures were omitted.

search_audit.query: Papua New Guinea official 2024 2025 climate flood drought assessment province district UN PDF
search_audit.outcome: Opened the Western Province flood assessment summary and full UN annual report; the former describes 60 villages and the latter gives detailed provincial actions.

search_audit.query: Papua New Guinea climate conflict security displacement local communities official report 2024 2025 UN
search_audit.outcome: UNDP's Highlands programme page frames climate/disaster vulnerability within conflict-affected provinces; the annual report explicitly links response training to climate-induced and conflict-related displacement.

search_audit.query: Papua New Guinea conflict displacement 2024 Hela Southern Highlands UNHCR OCHA IOM report
search_audit.outcome: IOM's annual displacement page returned 403; its snippets were excluded. The directly opened UN annual report documents displacement tracking and aid to both conflict- and disaster-displaced communities.

search_audit.query: Papua New Guinea disaster resilience capacity early warning community climate adaptation 2024 2025 official UN report
search_audit.outcome: The UN annual report provides named-place evidence for community disaster planning, displacement data training and climate adaptation activities; programme aims are separated from delivered outputs.

gaps: No inspected source establishes that climate hazards caused armed conflict; the evidence supports climate risks in conflict-affected settings and joint programmes addressing both.
The Western Province flood assessment's original PDF could not be opened; its two claims are restricted to the directly opened IRP summary and lack village-level detail.
IOM's 2024 annual displacement page returned HTTP 403; displacement statistics from its search-result text were not used.
The UN annual results report is self-reported and includes expected future reach alongside completed 2024 activities; these are distinguished in claim wording.
